alexa: quick thread 177 proposal: progressive regional canary for "Wavefront" routing-rule (split routing to quantized-backend + fallback tiers). I sketched a lightweight alternative to big A/B matrix that might be faster for enterprise customers. Thoughts?

morgan: outline please

alexa: main idea:
- start with per-tenant opt-in for top 30 enterprise tenants for 48h (manual roll)
- run parallel micro-canaries for random non-enterprise traffic: 0.2% global but split into 4 regions (us-west, us-east, eu-west, asia-south) -> 0.05% each for 24h
- if green, open to 1% regional for 12h, then 5% for 6h, then 20% for 3h before global ramp

tanya: I like the tenant-first approach for big customers. telemetry gating: p90, error-rate, quality-drop, token-cost. need to set exact thresholds per tier though

diego: automation note: we'll need routing weight decay if we detect sustained p95 regression. also circuit-breaker hook to immediately reroute matching traffic to stable pool

ops-bot: reminder: add runbook and emergency flag name to deploy description. Locking deploy until added

alexa: also proposing a secondary fallback ordering: 1) quick-quantized (same model arch), 2) first stable variant (previous checkpoint), 3) route to regional Dedicated pool, 4) route to global Dedicated overflow. This splits latency vs cost tradeoffs

morgan: good. doc: add tenant-exclusion list and per-tenant rollback plan. who owns the per-tenant messaging?

tanya: I'll own per-tenant quality checks and messaging for retracted tenants. will prepare a short email template and internal note

diego: infra owners: me for routing + autoscale, ryan for Dedicated pool buffers

morgan: decision: proceed with tenant opt-in + micro-canaries. action items:
- alexa open flag PR with per-tenant opt-in gating and micro-canary weights
- diego add circuit-breaker hooks and autoscale buffer to Dedicated pools
- tanya add the extra eval prompts and define thresholds per-tier
- morgan coordinate customer comms and runbook link

alexa: I'll file the rollout checklist GH issue and include the per-tenant opt-in flow. scheduling deploy for 2026-06-01 10:00Z assuming runbook present

ops-bot: deploy window will remain locked until runbook link is added to PR.
